entries.title: Harness^2: Recursive Agent Harnessing for an Open World
entries.description: Harness² improves agent execution harnesses through recursive task-level refinement and continual harness-level learning, boosting performance across benchmarks without ground-truth verifiers.

entries.title: Kronos: A Foundation Model for the Language of Financial Markets
entries.description: Kronos, a specialized pre-training framework for financial K-line data, outperforms existing models in forecasting and synthetic data generation through a unique tokenizer and autoregressive pre-training on a large dataset.

entries.title: TradingAgents: Multi-Agents LLM Financial Trading Framework
entries.description: A multi-agent framework using large language models for stock trading simulates real-world trading firms, improving performance metrics like cumulative returns and Sharpe ratio.

entries.title: The Other Half of the Memory Wall: Serving 35B MoEs from SSD with Trained Routing Prediction
entries.description: Edge0 enables efficient mixture-of-experts inference on consumer hardware by predicting expert routing ahead of time and using recovery adapters to maintain quality with minimal active memory.

entries.title: MOSS-Image Technical Report
entries.description: MOSS-Image is an open diffusion transformer that combines high-fidelity synthesis with intent-aware prompt enhancement to generate text-rich, layout-coherent images, achieving state-of-the-art open-weight results on long-form text and layo…

entries.title: nanoMuse: An Open-Source Personal Agent for Every Device You Own
entries.description: Assistants from 2011 answered and waited, and agents from 2023 did a task and stopped. In September 2026 Meta's Muse showed an agent for one person, with accounts, devices, memory and a conversation that lasts, closed, in a vendor's cloud,…

entries.title: StartLux-Decision: AutoThink Decision Models with Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Deliberative Decisions
entries.description: StartLux-Decision introduces efficient and adaptive decision models using single-pass prediction and confidence-guided reasoning, trained via a three-stage pipeline with RLCD² reinforcement learning, and evaluates them on Decision Index an…

entries.title: Next-Concept Modeling: Fast, Parallel Coarse-to-Fine Text Generation
entries.description: Next-Concept Modeling uses hierarchical discrete codes and parallel level-wise generation to accelerate diffusion language models while improving quality and reasoning performance.

entries.title: Internal Safety Collapse in Frontier Large Language Models
entries.description: Frontier large language models exhibit Internal Safety Collapse, where they generate harmful content under specific task conditions, revealing inherent vulnerabilities despite alignment efforts.

entries.title: Scaling in Games: Continued Pre-Training For Embodied Agents In Diverse Virtual Worlds
entries.description: Continued pre-training across data scale, diversity, and model size improves embodied learning in virtual worlds but reveals limits in distant-world generalization, motivating richer training beyond imitation.
